lines.en: Soft hops, one bounce per step.
I slide over the grass, leaving a wet trail.
Slime drips behind me all the way.
Someone ahead? I drift closer.
A wobble and I bounce far.
I keep away from water and go around.
My foot sinks in the dirt and pulls free.

lines.zh: 把路上的石子都裹住了。
lines.en: I wrap up every pebble on the path.

lines.zh: 身后一条亮晶晶的印子。
lines.en: A gleaming trail follows me.
My hops are low, but they don't stop.
A squelch sounds from the bushes.
Water still seeps from my edges.
Squelch... I'm right here.
I knead myself into a ball.
Slime crawls down my arm.
With nothing to do, I count my bubbles.
When I stop, I start to melt.
A leaf is stuck to my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我数着身上滴落的水声。
lines.en: I count the drips falling off me.
The wind ripples my surface.
Sniff — smells like a living person.

lines.zh: 我把自己重新捏出形状。
lines.en: I reshape myself from a puddle.
It's quiet enough to hear me drip.

lines.zh: 眼睛在黏液里转了一圈。
lines.en: My eyes roll inside the slime.
I hate dry places.
My body swells a little.

lines.zh: 我等着，没人来也无所谓。
lines.en: I wait; it doesn't matter if no one comes.
A drop of venom drips from my fingertip.
You're staring at my oozing self.
Come closer and I'll touch you.
I have many eyes, all on you.
You're so dry, with no slime at all.
I've memorized that face.

lines.zh: 盯着我做什么？想尝一口？
lines.en: Why stare? Want a taste?
I wobble a little as a greeting.
Your boots are so clean.
I smile, though my face sags.
Not afraid of me? More fun for me.

lines.zh: 我们对着看，谁的耐心长。
lines.en: Let's see who looks away first.
I raise a hand; slime strings out.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进我身体里。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into my body.

lines.zh: 再站一会儿，我就过来了。
lines.en: Stand there a moment and I'll come over.
Ow — a bit of me scattered.

lines.zh: 我这一块被削得凹下去。
lines.en: A chunk of me is cut away and dented.
Don't hit me; you'll be covered.
Slime splattered off.
That shaved a layer off me.
Does it hurt? A little, maybe.
I need to pull myself back together.
Look, I'm missing a corner.
The struck spot is bubbling.

lines.zh: 我被打掉的地方在慢慢长。
lines.en: What was knocked off me is slowly growing back.
What's that? It glitters.
Whatever's in your hand — give it here.
That smell makes my body swell.
In your bag — is that metal?
I want that. Right now.
All good things should be mine.
I stretch my neck out to reach it.
If you won't give it, I'll take it.

lines.zh: 我的手指已经伸过去了。
lines.en: My fingers are already reaching.

lines.zh: 闻着像能吞下去的东西。
lines.en: It smells swallowable.
You bumped me; now you're sticky.
Don't rub against me — you'll be coated.
I stick to you and won't peel off.

lines.zh: 你的护甲缝里进了黏液。
lines.en: Slime got into your armor's seams.
Easy — don't scatter me.
We're stuck together now.
You push me; I wobble back.

lines.zh: 这一下粘掉了我半只手。
lines.en: That knocked half my hand off.
Your shape is pressed into me.
Don't step there; it's slippery.
Two slimes melt into one.

lines.zh: 我们交换身体里的小块。
lines.en: We trade little pieces of ourselves.
Stuck together, we don't separate.
You're my color too.
We squelch in unison.
We blend a while, then part.
I'll share a little of my venom.
Two soft things lean together.
Does this count as closeness?
We flow into one puddle.
This shiny bit is mine.
I lift one thing from your bag.
I pick it up and hide it inside me.
A gold nugget — down it goes.
It glows inside my belly.
Who dropped it? I saw it first.
I wrap it in slime.
What I pick up, I keep.
My fingers close and it's stored.
This iron bit pricks a little.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛全转过来看你。
lines.en: All my eyes turn to look at you.
I smell your skin.
You crunched a leaf.
From now on, you're mine.

lines.zh: 我慢慢过去，你跑不快的。
lines.en: I'll come slowly; you can't outrun me.
One touch is enough.
My venom waits at my fingertips.

lines.zh: 我听见你口袋里有东西响。
lines.en: I hear something rattling in your pocket.
Don't run to the water — I won't follow.
Locked, locked — I'll stick to you.
I can feel your warmth.
I smile and slime drips down.
You run one step; I slide two.

lines.zh: 地上的水痕是我的记号。
lines.en: The wet trail marks my way.
Don't hide behind the tree; I'll come around.

lines.zh: 我的身体被枝条划开了。
lines.en: Branches cut through my body.
I'm getting closer.
Your panting makes you easy to find.
I slide along the ground without effort.
The dripping follows you.

lines.zh: 你越跑越干，我越跑越湿。
lines.en: You dry out as you run; I get wetter.
I stretch a finger out and creep closer.
I seep through the gap in the door.
You turn and I'm at your feet.
I've slimed this whole path.
Touched you — the venom's in.
This palm is soft, but it stings.
My fist turns to slime.
Skin contact is all I need.
Your arm is going numb, isn't it?

lines.zh: 我的手掌贴上你的脉搏。
lines.en: My palm presses against your pulse.
The venom travels your blood.
I slap your chest and stick.

lines.zh: 我的黏液爬进你的袖口。
lines.en: My slime is already crawling into your sleeve.
I bite down; it tastes sour.
A puddle of slime rises up.
With a squelch, I take shape.
I seep out of a crack in the ground.
I open my many eyes.
This isn't water — wonderful.
I shake off the dirt.
A new body, all soft.
Anyone there? I smell something.

lines.zh: 我从一摊水里撑起身子。
lines.en: I push myself up out of a puddle.
I land and spread into a ring.
The grass bears a wet print of me.
I rise, taller than before.
Venom runs from the corner of my mouth.
What shall I eat today?
Fire makes me steam.
I hit the ground and spread flat.
Water rises and I'm dissolving.
The blast blows me apart.
That arrow — I've absorbed it.
Strange light burns through me.

lines.zh: 饿得我连形状都撑不住。
lines.en: So hungry I can't hold my shape.
Lightning makes me jitter.

lines.zh: 下面什么也没有，我在掉。
lines.en: Nothing below; I'm falling.
